page.title: Auto-assignment
page.subtitle: Give each new conversation to the right agent automatically. Rules are tried in order, from the top.
page.noAccess: You do not have permission to view the auto-assignment settings.
page.limitReached: You have used all {limit} rules your plan allows.
page.keepTitle: Keep returning contacts with their agent
page.keepBody: When a contact who already has an agent writes in again, the new conversation goes to that agent first: the contact's owner, or whoever handled their last conversation, as long as they are still an active agent. Otherwise the rules below decide.
page.howItWorks: The first rule that matches and finds an available agent gets the conversation. The fallback rule is used when no other rule matched. If nothing matches, the conversation stays unassigned.
page.loadFailed: The rules could not be loaded.
page.empty: Create a rule to give new conversations to your agents in turn, by keyword, channel, language or contact details.
page.duplicated: Rule copied. The copy is switched off.
page.deleteMessage: "{name}" will stop assigning conversations. Conversations it already assigned stay as they are.

rules.unavailable: {count, plural, one {# agent unavailable} other {# agents unavailable}}

when.contact: {count, plural, one {# contact condition} other {# contact conditions}}

rules.flowGone: Also starts a flow that was deleted

form.noAccess: You do not have permission to change the auto-assignment rules.
form.loadFailed: The rule could not be loaded.
form.subtitle: Say which conversations the rule is for and who should get them.
form.conflict: This rule was changed by someone else while you were editing it. Go back to the list and open it again.
form.limit: Your plan does not allow more rules.
form.fixProblems: Please add only valid rules: fix the highlighted fields and save again.
form.name: Rule name
form.descriptionHint: Optional. A note for your team about what the rule is for.

problem.name: Enter a name for the rule.
problem.conditions: Add at least one condition, or mark this rule as the fallback.
problem.contactIncomplete: Finish or remove the contact conditions that are not complete.
problem.targets: Choose at least one agent or team.
problem.specific: Choose exactly one agent for a specific agent.

form.whenHint: Every condition you set must match. Leave a part empty to ignore it.

contact.title: The contact matches
contact.hint: Tags, owner, lifecycle stage and other contact details, as in segments.
contact.partial: Some contact lists could not be loaded, so some choices may be missing.

channel.title: Channel
channel.hint: Only conversations that arrive on these channels. None ticked means any channel.

keywords.title: Message words
keywords.hint: Words or phrases in the customer's first message, separated by commas. Capital letters do not matter.

language.title: Customer language
language.hint: Language codes separated by commas, such as en, ar. Only when the language is known.

hours.title: Business hours
hours.hint: Uses the business hours of your workspace.

form.thenHint: Agents who are inactive, offline, busy or cannot open the inbox are skipped.

strategyHint.round_robin: Round robin: the conversations go to the chosen agents in turn, so everyone gets the same share. The rule remembers whose turn is next.
strategyHint.least_busy: Least busy: the conversation goes to the agent with the fewest open conversations right now.
strategyHint.specific: A specific agent: every matching conversation goes to this one person.

form.agentsHint: Choose people, teams or both. A team means its members.
form.agentsFailed: The list of agents could not be loaded. You need access to the inbox to choose agents.
form.noAgents: There are no agents who can open the inbox yet.
form.stale: {count, plural, one {# chosen agent or team is no longer available.} other {# chosen agents or teams are no longer available.}}
form.stopOnMatchHint: On: later rules are not checked. Off: a later matching rule can take the conversation over.
form.fallbackHint: Used when no other rule matched. There is only one fallback; choosing this one replaces the previous one.

flow.title: Also start a flow
flow.hint: Optional. The flow starts for the conversation when this rule fires, on the same channel. It only has to be switched on; it does not have to be published.
flow.goneOption: A flow that no longer exists
flow.loadFailed: The flows could not be loaded, so the choice may be incomplete.
